The three existing skipped assertions remain visible; none was added to suppress failures.
Some tests require external extracted research data, and some assertions target obsolete interfaces; unresolved cases have not all been classified as harmless.
No claim of complete model self-collision or universal human-anatomy realism.
Real private-repository access must still be verified when repository visibility actually changes.
